Adenocarcinoma originates in esophageal glandular epithelium; cough and chest pain do not establish other organ damage.
Clonal megakaryocyte and platelet neoplasm; thromboses and infarctions are separately diagnosed complications despite high supplied HPO frequencies.
Obstetric fetal growth disorder; low fetal weight alone does not establish damage to an organ axis.
Infiltrative fibroblastic neoplasm of soft connective tissues; no additional organ is consistently affected across the umbrella.
Benign tumor arising from thyroid follicular cells; hormone secretion is not universal.
Benign sympathetic neuronal tumor. HPO intestinal polyposis/neurofibromatosis (30-79%) represents syndromic associations, not usual direct gut involvement; adrenal dysfunction is unproven.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: intestinal neurofibromatosis and polyposis are associated syndromic conditions; their HPO frequencies do not establish direct gut damage across ganglioneuromas.

basis: Carcinoma originates in thyroid follicular cells; local vascular invasion does not establish a separate cardiovascular disorder.
Neuroblastic neoplasm of the sympathetic neural lineage; variable anatomical sites do not establish a second organ across the group.
Adenocarcinoma originating in the glandular epithelium of the stomach.
Adenocarcinoma originating in the stomach; intestinal describes its histologic pattern.
Reproductive system umbrella has no axis; endocrine involvement applies to selected subtypes rather than most patients across the group.
Site-unspecified germ-cell tumor umbrella, predominantly reproductive/gonadal; extragonadal subtypes have no shared organ axis.
Glaucoma affects the eye and optic nerve; optic nerve injury belongs to the ocular axis.
Persistent systemic arterial hypertension; renal, cerebral and cardiac complications are separately diagnosed diseases.
Myocardial hypertrophy defines the disease; extracardiac features of rare syndromic subtypes do not characterize the umbrella.
Defined by immune system dysfunction; no additional organ is common across this broad umbrella.
Reproductive functional disorder; heterogeneous underlying causes do not establish a shared endocrine or other organ-axis disease.
Tumor arises in endocrine pancreatic beta cells. Neuroglycopenic episodes do not establish lasting neurologic damage; associated MEN1 tumors are separate diseases.
Mixed ductal and lobular carcinoma originates in breast tissue, which has no axis.
Carcinoma originates in breast lobules, outside the axes; invasion alone does not establish common involvement of another organ.
Defined by chronic functional bowel dysfunction; no additional direct organ damage or immune-mediated disease is established.
Vascular insufficiency defines ischemic disease; the injured target organ varies across subtypes and cannot be assigned across the umbrella.
HHV8-associated vascular malignancy predominantly affecting skin; gastrointestinal involvement is annotated 30-79%. Retinal and CNS findings do not establish direct tumor injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: the defining endothelial vascular neoplasm, supported by its angiosarcoma ancestry, establishes vascular origin in addition to its usual cutaneous location.

basis: Most LCNECs arise in lung; extrapulmonary sites are minority subtypes. Neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine-gland disease.
audit_reason: Replace metabolic_endocrine with pulmonary: most large cell neuroendocrine carcinomas arise in lung. Neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish an endocrine-gland disorder; the umbrella rule follows most patients.

basis: Malignant smooth-muscle soft-tissue neoplasm; organ-specific sites vary. EBV association is not universal; no additional organ qualifies across the umbrella.
Malignancy of hematopoietic cells in marrow and blood; splenic involvement shares this axis. Other organ infiltration is not consistently common across leukemia subtypes.
Adipocytic sarcoma usually arises in deep soft tissue. The 80-99% subcutaneous-nodule annotation conflicts with usual tumor depth; common subcutis occupation is not established.

decisions.dermatologic: none: liposarcoma usually arises in deep soft tissue; the subcutaneous-nodule annotation does not reliably establish common subcutis origin or occupation.

basis: Malignant glandular epithelial tumor arising in the lung; distant metastases are separately diagnosed disease.
Clonal lymphocyte malignancy establishes the blood-cell axis; lymphoma explicitly receives the immune axis. No extranodal organ is common across the umbrella.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast has no axis. Lymphoplasmacytic stromal infiltration does not make this a lymphoma or immune disease.
Most mesotheliomas arise in the pleura; peritoneal and other sites represent minority subtypes of this umbrella.
Umbrella defined by abnormal metabolic processes; no additional organ is consistently damaged across the group.
Synovial sarcoma arises in mesenchymal soft tissue, commonly deep periarticular tissue.
Ischemic necrosis of heart muscle; coronary thrombosis remains within the cardiovascular axis.
Site-unspecified neoplasm umbrella spans organs inside and outside the axes; no particular organ can be assigned across most cases.
Umbrella disorder of the brain, spinal cord or peripheral nerves; additional axes are subtype-specific.
Sympathetic nervous system tumor; marrow infiltration occurs in roughly 30-40%, supporting frequent anemia and thrombocytopenia; other organ damage is less consistently common.
Benign melanocytic neoplasm predominantly arising in skin; ocular and neurologic subtypes do not characterize most patients.
Papillary carcinoma originates in thyroid follicular cells.
Biofilm-associated inflammatory destruction of tooth-supporting tissues; periodontal structures belong to the oral gastrointestinal axis.
Bordetella pertussis directly infects the respiratory tract; neurologic and other organ complications are uncommon.
Arises in breast or rarely prostate, both outside the axes; metastases are not typical across this predominantly benign/borderline umbrella.
Site-variable umbrella; gastrointestinal epithelial polyps predominate and are emphasized in the definition. Other sites are subtype-specific.
Hypertension of the hepatic portal venous circulation. Underlying cirrhosis and separately diagnosed varices, hypersplenism or encephalopathy do not add axes.
Hypertension and proteinuric renal injury define disease; pulmonary edema is a major severe diagnostic feature and annotated at 30-79%; hepatic and neurologic damage are minority features.
Tumour originates in prostate glandular epithelium, a reproductive site outside the axes; metastases are not defining involvement.
Immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease; psoriatic arthritis is a separately diagnosed disease.
Broad psychiatric umbrella defined by disrupted mental processes; brain ancestry alone does not establish neurologic organ damage.
Fibrovascular conjunctival growth extends onto the cornea and can impair vision.
Carcinoma originates in kidney epithelium; metastatic sites are not intrinsic defining organ involvement.
Umbrella explicitly defined by disease of the respiratory system; infection or immune mediation does not apply across the entire group.
Umbrella malignancy of bone and mesenchymal soft tissues, including muscle, cartilage and fibrous tissue; individual visceral sites do not define the group.
Psychotic disorder falls within the explicit psychiatric exclusion; cognitive symptoms alone do not add a neurologic axis.
SARS coronavirus respiratory infection; kidney injury is rare, while headache and myalgia do not establish organ damage.
Umbrella disorder defined by abnormal skin or subcutaneous structure or function; no shared additional organ damage.
Immune-mediated inflammatory arthritis and enthesitis define the group; uveitis is not consistently above 30%, and associated bowel or skin diseases are separate.
Carcinoma originates in bronchial epithelium; metastatic sites and paraneoplastic complications are not defining organ involvement.
Cerebral vascular hemorrhage or occlusion causes acute loss of brain function.
Cerebrovascular hemorrhage involves ruptured intracranial vessels and the subarachnoid CNS compartment; bleeding alone does not establish a blood-cell or coagulation disorder.
audit_reason: Add cardiovascular to primary: subarachnoid hemorrhage is a cerebrovascular hemorrhage involving rupture of intracranial vessels. Neurologic remains primary for its CNS location; bleeding does not itself justify haematologic.

basis: Autoimmune skin fibrosis; GI dysfunction 80-99% and pulmonary fibrosis 30-79%. Vascular, musculoskeletal and reported renal involvement omitted by the four-axis cap.
Immune-mediated inflammation and ulceration of colorectal mucosa; extraintestinal diseases are separate diagnoses or minority manifestations.
Definition specifies an embryonal mesenchymal malignancy arising in the liver.
Adipocytic sarcoma commonly arises in deep soft tissues; subcutaneous nodules annotated in 80-99% support subcutis. Gastrointestinal and renal findings are only 5-29%.
audit_reason: Add musculoskeletal to primary for the defining soft-tissue sarcoma, commonly arising in deep limb and trunk tissues. Retain dermatologic for the supplied very frequent subcutaneous involvement.

basis: Low-grade sarcoma is a mesenchymal connective-tissue malignancy; grade does not establish additional organ involvement.
Most melanomas originate in skin; other primary sites are minority subtypes, and organ metastases are separately diagnosed.
Benign adipose tumor, usually in subcutaneous tissue; uncommon organ-specific lipoma subtypes do not establish additional involvement across the group.
Viral infection defines this umbrella; no single anatomical organ is consistently affected across its subtypes.
HIV infection directly impairs immunity; opportunistic infections and separately diagnosed organ complications are excluded.
Disease of myocardium of unknown cause; neither immune disease nor skeletal muscle involvement applies across the umbrella.
EBV infection defines the mechanism. Across this broad concept, symptomatic mononucleosis and hepatitis cannot be assumed; hepatitis is also a separately defined disease.
Pleural tumour origin; direct invasion of chest-wall or diaphragmatic muscle is common (approximately >=30%) over its usual locally progressive course.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: the definition describes progression into chest-wall muscle; direct muscle invasion is common, approximately >=30% over the typical disease course.

basis: Bacterial infection defines the mechanism; no single anatomical organ is affected across most of this broad group.
Pathogen-defined infection umbrella with variable sites; respiratory damage is not established in most patients across the group.

decisions.pulmonary: none: pneumonia and sinusitis are site-specific presentations; their combined frequency across this umbrella is not established.

basis: Recurrent focal seizures arise in the temporal lobe.
Intestinal bacterial infection; arthritis and neurologic regression/myoclonus annotated 80-99%. Uveitis and pleuritis annotated 30-79% omitted under cap.
Bacterial infection with variable intestinal, cutaneous or systemic localization; no single organ is established across the umbrella.
Anaplasma directly infects neutrophils and commonly causes cytopenias; transient transaminase elevations do not establish lasting hepatic damage.
Bacillus anthracis infection; cutaneous ulcerative disease accounts for about 95% of naturally acquired cases. Pulmonary and gastrointestinal forms are minority subtypes.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: skin is a defined infection site and cutaneous disease accounts for about 95% of naturally acquired anthrax, supporting the umbrella label.

basis: Bacterial infection with variable sites; intestinal colonization does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Bacterial infection mechanism is explicit; the definition describes plant soft rot and establishes no human target organ.
Chronic infection directly affects skin and peripheral nerves. Muscle atrophy (30-79%) is secondary to denervation; ocular and upper airway damage are below 30%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: muscle atrophy is annotated 30-79%, but usually results from peripheral nerve denervation rather than direct muscle infection or a defining myopathy.

basis: Borderline leprosy is a mycobacterial infection defined by skin lesions and peripheral nerve involvement.
Mycobacterial infection defined by persistent skin lesions and pronounced peripheral nerve damage.
Mycobacterial skin and peripheral nerve infection; infiltrative, destructive nasal mucosal disease affects most untreated cases (~80%). Ocular involvement omitted at cap.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: nasal mucosal infiltration with chronic inflammation, ulceration and atrophy occurs in most untreated lepromatous cases (~80%); nose is pulmonary.

basis: Crystalline lens opacity directly impairs vision; causes associated with particular cataract subtypes are not universal.
Gluten-triggered autoimmune injury to small-intestinal villi; anemia and osteoporosis are secondary, separately diagnosed conditions.
Carcinoma originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; HPV association alone does not make the carcinoma an infection.
CMV infection is usually asymptomatic; retinitis, gastrointestinal disease and pneumonia are separately defined manifestations in selected patients.
Predominantly reproductive/pelvic disease. Bowel, urinary and cutaneous involvement are minority site-specific forms, not common damage across the umbrella.
Broad infectious umbrella with variable tissue sites; no anatomical organ is consistently affected across the group.
Plasmodium infects erythrocytes. Kidney and CNS injury characterize severe subsets; supplied high frequencies are not representative of malaria overall.
Broad disorder of nutrient intake and utilization; no additional organ damage is common across the umbrella.
Carcinoma originates in lung epithelium; metastatic organ disease is separately diagnosed.
Severe obesity is a metabolic disorder; associated cardiovascular, hepatic and joint diseases are separately diagnosed complications.
Carcinoma originates in ovarian epithelium, a reproductive tissue outside the axes; metastatic sites are separate secondary malignancies.
Bacterial infection umbrella encompassing multiple sites; no single anatomical organ is consistently affected across the group.
Bacterial infection defined by Pseudomonas strain; no anatomical infection site is specified.
Bacterial infection defined by Pseudomonas strain; no anatomical infection site is specified.
Inherited motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting and ventilatory weakness result from denervation rather than direct muscle or lung disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: denervation atrophy is common, but the disease directly targets motor neurons rather than skeletal muscle.

basis: Progressive motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting and respiratory weakness arise from denervation rather than primary muscle or lung disease.
Psychiatric trauma-related disorder without qualifying direct organ damage.
Autoimmune destruction of endocrine pancreatic beta cells causes insulin deficiency. Retinopathy, nephropathy and neuropathy are separately diagnosed complications.
Insulin resistance and hyperglycemia define the disease; retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy and vascular disease are separately diagnosed complications.
Hypertension of the pulmonary vasculature; underlying lung disease is a separate cause, not direct pulmonary injury from this concept.
Degeneration of the retinal macula causes central visual loss.
Defined as disease of the endocrine system; additional organ damage is subtype-dependent.
Loss of anterior pituitary hormone secretion defines this endocrine disorder.
Tumour originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside these axes; HPV association does not make the carcinoma an infection.
Umbrella for liver disease; endocrine, immune and extrahepatic manifestations are not shared across the group.
Fibrosis and regenerative nodules damage the liver; portal hypertension, varices and hepatic encephalopathy are separately diagnosed complications.
Inflammation of brain and spinal cord, typically infectious or immune-mediated; no other organ is consistently affected across the umbrella.
Lymphocytic and plasma-cell neoplasm umbrella. Lymphoma-specific immune labeling is subtype-dependent; lymphoid lineage alone does not establish an immune mechanism.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: this broader category is not itself lymphoma or an immune-mediated disease; the lymphoma-specific mechanism label is not established for the umbrella.

basis: Primary carcinoma of a reproductive organ outside the axes; metastases and urinary obstruction are not universal defining involvement.
Aortic wall aneurysm, including rupture, is arterial disease; downstream complications do not establish common additional organ involvement.
HPV infection defines the mechanism axis; anatomical sites vary across this umbrella. Warts, dysplasia and cancers are separate manifestations or diagnoses.
Malignant fibroblastic tumour of soft connective tissue and bone; organ-specific visceral subtypes do not establish involvement across the umbrella.
Benign bone-forming neoplasm; sinus obstruction is an occasional local complication.
Neoplasm of immature lymphoid blood cells, including acute lymphoblastic leukemia; lymphoma is not established across this concept.
Mature T/NK lymphoid neoplasms, predominantly lymphomas; no additional organ site applies across most subtypes.
Neoplastic proliferation of myeloid blood-forming cells; no additional organ damage applies consistently across the umbrella.
Defined as a disease of the skeletal system; no additional organ applies across this umbrella.
Localized epidermal precancerous lesion composed of atypical keratinocytes.
Acute reduction of arterial blood pressure; secondary organ ischemia is not established by this diagnosis alone.
Immune inflammatory infiltration targets the endocrine pancreatic islets, particularly in type 1 diabetes.
Immune inflammatory infiltration of pancreatic islets; endocrine pancreas belongs to the metabolic_endocrine axis.
Degeneration of articular cartilage with adjacent bone and synovial changes; this is not an autoimmune disease.
Benign ovarian epithelial adenoma; reproductive tissue origin without a defined endocrine disorder lies outside the axes.
Progressive degeneration of central dopaminergic neurons; rigidity and autonomic symptoms do not establish separate organ injury.
Mitochondrial metabolic myopathy directly affects extraocular and eyelid muscles, producing progressive loss of ocular movement.
Predominantly an ovarian benign neoplasm, outside the axes; uncommon pancreatic examples do not characterize most patients across the umbrella.
Benign ovarian epithelial tumour; reproductive tissue without defined endocrine dysfunction has no axis.
Malignancy originates in exocrine pancreatic ducts. Hepatic metastases are separately diagnosed secondary cancers; jaundice alone does not establish direct hepatic damage.

decisions.hepatic: none: liver metastases are separately diagnosed secondary malignancies; obstructive jaundice alone does not establish qualifying hepatic tissue damage.

basis: Autoimmune/autoinflammatory childhood arthritis. Uveitis and systemic organ complications do not affect at least 30% across the umbrella.
Substance-use disorder without defined intrinsic organ damage; cardiovascular and other toxic complications are separate diseases.
HHV8 infection; associated Kaposi sarcoma is a separate disease, not direct common skin damage from infection.
HHV8-associated sarcoma typically involving skin; endothelial differentiation does not establish additional cardiovascular disease. No individual visceral site reliably reaches 30%.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: vascular endothelial differentiation alone does not establish additional disease of the heart or native vessels.

basis: Stenosis directly affects the carotid artery; cerebral infarction is a possible separately diagnosed complication.
Usually cutaneous origin; this umbrella includes regional nodal spread. Liver, lung and brain involvement is not established at ≥30% across the whole group.
audit_reason: Remove hepatic, pulmonary and neurologic: frequencies from distant metastatic disease do not establish ≥30% involvement across this broader concept, which also includes regional-node metastasis.

basis: Carcinoma arises in the exocrine pancreas, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Intraepithelial neoplasia confined to the prostate, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Rotavirus infects intestinal enterocytes and causes gastroenteritis.
Microbial infection and inflammation of the peritoneum; secondary multiorgan dysfunction is not a defining organ manifestation.
Thymic gland tumour classified under endocrine gland neoplasm; associated autoimmune disease is separate, and epithelial thymic tumours are not blood-cell neoplasms.
Noninvasive neoplasia of vulvar epithelium; reproductive organs have no axis.
Dilated myocardial disease explicitly caused by viral infection.
Myocardial stiffness causes restrictive ventricular filling; systemic causes do not establish other organ involvement across this umbrella.
IgE-mediated hypersensitivity defines the disorder; asthma, dermatitis, rhinitis and food allergy are separately diagnosed manifestations or associated diseases.
Autoimmune hypercoagulability with arterial or venous thrombosis as a major diagnostic manifestation; obstetric manifestations have no organ axis.
Carcinoma arising in renal parenchyma or renal pelvis; metastatic organ involvement is not inherent.
Predominantly uterine/placental trophoblastic cancer; ovarian and testicular origins also lack an axis. Lung metastases are not established at >=30% across all cases.
Melanoma originates in the skin; distant metastases are not defining involvement.
Sarcoma originates in the uterine corpus, a reproductive organ outside the axes; uterine smooth muscle does not establish skeletal muscle disease.
Serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary is a reproductive organ malignancy; no other axis is intrinsically defined.
Malignant mesenchymal tumour with skeletal muscle differentiation; anatomical sites vary, so no additional organ is consistent across the umbrella.
Carcinoma originates in the uterus, a reproductive organ outside the defined axes.
Tumor arises in the vulva, a reproductive organ outside the axes; mesenchymal histology alone does not establish musculoskeletal involvement.
Carcinoma arising in the vulva, a reproductive organ outside the specified axes.
Carcinoma arising in the hypopharynx; pharyngeal structures belong to the pulmonary axis.
Inherited disease of cardiac muscle. Extracardiac findings belong to particular subtypes and do not characterize most patients across the umbrella.
Fibrosis and cyst formation confined to breast parenchyma; breast has no axis.
Carcinoma arising from epithelial cells of the renal collecting ducts.
Urothelial carcinoma originating in the renal pelvis.
Acute malignant myeloid blast proliferation in bone marrow and blood; no additional organ damage established as common.
Acute myeloid malignancy of blood and marrow; no common direct extramedullary organ damage is established for this subtype.
Localized pus-forming infection; the umbrella concept specifies no single anatomical organ.
Bacterial infection causing sepsis; bacteremia does not itself establish blood-cell disease or a consistently damaged additional organ.
Bacterial infection directly inflames the dermis and subcutaneous tissue.
Hepatitis C is a viral infection of the liver; extrahepatic complications are separate diseases or insufficiently common.
Site-unspecified histologic umbrella; lung primaries predominate clinically. Other anatomical sites occur in distinct subtypes.
Carcinoma originates in the lung; metastatic sites are not consistently involved across this broad group.
Clonal plasma cell marrow disease explicitly lacking attributable organ impairment; bone and renal damage are excluded by definition.
Localized cutaneous/subcutaneous lipid-laden histiocytic lesions, classified as a metabolic disease; associated systemic lipid disorders require separate assessment.
Adipocytic soft-tissue sarcoma typically arising in deep extremity connective tissues; no specific visceral origin is established.
Umbrella concept explicitly defined by disease involving the kidney.
Bacterial pus accumulation, usually occupying the pleural space; nonpleural subtypes do not justify additional axes across the umbrella.
Disorder of peripheral nerves; weakness alone does not establish direct skeletal muscle damage.
Pyogenic infection affects bone and its marrow compartment; the explicit bone-marrow-disorder parent supports the marrow axis.

decisions.haematologic: primary: osteomyelitis directly infects marrow as well as bone; the marrow axis does not require cytopenia.

basis: Bacterial infection directly affecting the urinary tract, including bladder and urethra.
Definition specifies infection causing inflammation of lung parenchyma.
Inflammation confined to placental villi; placenta has no axis, and an infectious or autoimmune cause is not specified.
Failure of cardiac pump function; pulmonary congestion is a haemodynamic manifestation, while cardiorenal disease is a separate diagnosis.
Heart failure with elevated cardiac output; underlying causes do not establish additional organ involvement.
Symptomatic cardiac pump dysfunction; dyspnea and fatigue alone do not establish pulmonary or skeletal-muscle damage.
Defined by impaired cardiac function; mild breathlessness does not establish direct pulmonary disease.
Defined by impaired cardiac function; activity limitation does not establish damage to other organs.
Severe cardiac pump failure; associated renal disease and congestion do not establish additional qualifying organ involvement.
A neurodevelopmental disorder affecting communication, social interaction and behavior; no additional organ damage defines the umbrella.
A neurodevelopmental disorder defined by impaired social communication and restricted, repetitive behavior.
Congenital or acquired cyst located in the central nervous system; endocrine involvement is not general across this umbrella.
Transient cerebral dysfunction from cerebrovascular ischemia defines the condition; no persistent neurological deficit or additional organ damage is required.
Immune-mediated intestinal inflammation; extraintestinal diseases are separately diagnosed or do not consistently reach 30% across this umbrella.
Diabetic metabolic retinal disease is defined by direct retinal capillary injury, microaneurysms, leakage and abnormal vascular growth.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: retinal microangiopathy directly damages capillaries, explicitly included in the cardiovascular axis; generalized vascular disease is not required.

basis: Disease of the heart or pericardium; no additional organ involvement applies across this umbrella.
Disease located in the carotid artery; cerebral injury is a possible complication rather than a defining universal feature.
IgE-mediated hypersensitivity defines the mechanism; affected anatomical sites vary across allergic disease subtypes.
Clonal marrow disorder with single-lineage dysplasia and ineffective blood cell production; cardiac dysfunction is occasional.
Defined as disease involving the lung; no additional mechanism or organ applies across the umbrella.
Dental hard-tissue destruction from acid-producing dysbiotic biofilm; caries alone does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated disease.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: biofilm-mediated tooth demineralization does not by itself establish an infection or immune-mediated disorder.

basis: Primary neurologic headache disorder; vascular terminology, nausea and photophobia do not establish separate vessel, gastrointestinal or ocular damage.
Embolic obstruction of pulmonary arteries is vascular disease; pulmonary infarction occurs in a minority and is not required.
Prostatic inflammation affects a reproductive organ outside the axes. Infection or autoimmune disease is not established across this umbrella.
Gallbladder disease; the gallbladder belongs to the hepatic axis.
Autoimmune disease defined by lupus-specific skin lesions; associated systemic lupus is a separate diagnosis.
Disease of the retina, assigned to the ocular axis despite its nervous-system ancestry.
Progressive autoimmune CNS demyelination; optic neuritis is separately diagnosed, and additional direct ocular damage affecting >=30% of this subgroup is not established.

decisions.ocular: none: optic neuritis is a separately diagnosed manifestation; visual symptoms alone do not establish additional ocular damage meeting the threshold in progressive MS.

basis: Tumor of the palate, classified as an oral cavity neoplasm.
Persistent neurodevelopmental impairment defines the concept; additional affected organs depend on the underlying condition.
Abnormal tissue mass arises from the intestinal wall and protrudes into its lumen.
Neoplasm of the paranasal sinuses, which belong to the upper respiratory tract.
Aneurysm of an intracranial artery; neurologic injury from rupture or compression is not intrinsic to every aneurysm or established as common.
Inflammation of the colon; this umbrella includes ischemic, chemical, infectious and immune causes, so a specific mechanism axis is not universal.
Structural collapse of the foot's longitudinal arch.
Umbrella disorder of peripheral arteries and veins; no additional organ injury is common across its subtypes.
Peripheral arterial disease causing exertional muscle ischemia; reversible pain and weakness do not establish lasting skeletal-muscle damage.
Sleep-related respiratory dysfunction; central neurologic causes apply to a subtype, and cardiovascular sequelae are separately diagnosed diseases.
Urethral inflammation; infectious mechanism supported by bacterial urinary tract infection ancestry and infectious subtypes.
Metabolic bone disease defined by reduced bone mass and disrupted cortical/trabecular architecture, causing skeletal fragility; endocrine causes need not be present.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: osteoporosis is a metabolic bone disorder of bone remodeling, explicitly supported by its parent; the mechanism axis does not require an endocrine cause.

basis: Cerebrovascular arterial obstruction causes diminished brain perfusion and neurologic damage; both brain and vascular disease define the concept.
Persistent kidney damage and impaired renal function define CKD; associated anaemia and mineral-bone disorders are separately diagnosed complications.
Autoimmune CNS demyelination; direct optic nerve involvement causes optic neuritis in approximately 50% over the disease course.
ADHD is a neurodevelopmental disorder, explicitly covered by the neurologic axis.
Substance dependence is outside the axes; associated organ diseases are separate diagnoses and vary by substance.
Neoplasm involves the biliary tract; intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts belong to the hepatic axis.
Immune-mediated axial arthritis; anterior uveitis is a direct extra-articular inflammatory manifestation affecting approximately 30-40% over the disease course.

decisions.ocular: involved: anterior uveitis affects approximately 30-40% over the course and is a recognized inflammatory manifestation of the disease.

basis: Heterogeneous umbrella with renal disease predominating across prevalent ciliopathies; retinal, neurological, skeletal and airway damage depend on subtype.
Atrial electrical rhythm disorder.
Atherosclerotic plaque directly damages arterial walls; downstream infarctions are separately diagnosed diseases.
Inflammation of ileal pouch mucosa. Associated C. difficile colitis is a separate infection; inflammation alone does not establish an immune mechanism.
Bacterial invasion and inflammation cause intestinal wall necrosis. Blood-count and electrolyte changes do not establish direct organ damage; sepsis and DIC occur in <30%.
Immune-mediated CNS demyelination; direct optic nerve involvement occurs in roughly half over the course. Neurogenic bladder does not itself establish urinary tract damage.
Bacterial infection of the vagina supports the infection mechanism axis; the reproductive site has no anatomical axis.
Recurrent ulceration directly affects oral mucosa; the supplied definition establishes neither infection nor a specific immune-mediated disease.
Corneal endothelial degeneration causes corneal edema, opacity and progressive visual impairment.
Bacterial infections transmitted sexually; no single anatomical axis is consistently affected across this umbrella.
Allergen-mediated inflammation of nasal airways; no additional organ damage established.
Ultraviolet injury and inflammation of skin; no autoimmune or infectious mechanism.
Umbrella concept defined by disease affecting the eye.
Elevated circulating thyroxine; umbrella includes euthyroid binding-protein disorders without systemic organ damage.
Inherited nephritis with progressive renal dysfunction; hearing loss depends on the Alport subtype and is not established at ≥30% across this heterogeneous group.
Neoplasm originates in colon or rectum; lymphoma is only one subtype, so an immune label does not apply across the umbrella.
Defined by skeletal muscle fiber dysfunction; additional organs depend on the specific myopathy.
Ocular drainage dysfunction and glaucomatous optic nerve damage; optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis.
Progressive scalp hair-follicle miniaturization; androgen sensitivity does not establish an endocrine gland disorder.
Autoimmune injury to hair follicles causes patchy scalp and body hair loss.
Carcinoma originating in epidermal basal cells or pilosebaceous units; muscle and bone invasion are uncommon advanced complications.
Immune-complex IgA deposition causes glomerular inflammation; hypertension is occasional and associated hepatic or intestinal diseases are separate conditions.
Hepatitis B viral infection targets the liver; extrahepatic disorders are uncommon or separately diagnosed.
Congenital urethral opening malformation; the urethra belongs to the renal axis despite the reproductive-system parent.
Stones occupy the gallbladder or bile ducts, both included in the hepatic axis.
Disorder of triglyceride metabolism; pancreatitis and vascular disease are separate potential complications.
Persistent excessive dermal collagen deposition forms an expanding cutaneous scar.
Pathologic remodeling of the otic capsule and stapes impairs hearing; localized ear bone disease does not imply locomotor involvement.
Aneurysmal dilatation of the abdominal aorta; downstream ischemic complications do not define additional organ involvement.
Eating disorder assigned no axis under the specified psychiatric exclusion.
Psychiatric behavioral disorder; the developmental parent category does not establish neurologic organ damage.
Chronic viral infection of the liver; cirrhosis and extrahepatic immune complications are separate diseases or minority manifestations.
Recurrent narrowing of a coronary artery.
Coronary arterial smooth-muscle spasm narrows the lumen and reduces myocardial blood flow.
Transmissible prion disease causing spongiform brain degeneration; cortical visual loss and neurogenic weakness do not establish separate eye or muscle damage.
Dengue infection with thrombocytopenia and hemorrhage; vascular permeability with plasma leakage is a defining criterion, even without shock.
Drug or chemical toxicity directly injures the liver; an immune mechanism does not apply across this umbrella.
Chronic allergic, immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation of the oesophagus.
Sexual dysfunction of the male reproductive system; vascular, neurologic and endocrine causes are not universal defining features.
Inherited podocyte disease causes focal segmental glomerular scarring; immune mediation is not intrinsic to this group.
Autoimmune thyroid hyperfunction. Clinically significant orbitopathy is around 25-30% and separately diagnosed; transient ocular signs do not establish damage.
Defined by partial or complete hearing loss. Central and syndromic subtypes do not justify additional axes across the umbrella.
Chronic viral infection of the liver; extrahepatic complications are uncommon, and cirrhosis is a separately diagnosed disease.
Substance-use disorder has no axis; overdose injury and injection-associated infections are separate conditions.
Endocrine neoplasm umbrella, predominantly gastrointestinal in origin. Pulmonary origin is a minority subtype; hormone secretion and cardiac injury are not universal.
Purely psychiatric mood-disorder umbrella; the brain-disorder ancestor does not establish neurologic damage.
Reproductive dysfunction; endocrine disease or damage to another covered organ is not inherent to male infertility.
Meningococcal infection; meningitis directly inflames CNS in roughly 50-70% of invasive cases; shock and DIC do not justify additional common organ labels.
Neoplasm occupying bone marrow, whether primary or metastatic; marrow belongs to the haematologic axis.
Neoplasm arising in the nasopharynx, which belongs to the upper respiratory airway axis.
Immune-complex deposition damages glomeruli and causes membranous nephropathy; no additional organ is intrinsic to the umbrella disease.
Glomerular dysfunction defines nephrotic syndrome; edema, hypoalbuminemia and hyperlipidemia do not establish damage to additional organs.
Purely psychiatric disorder involving anxiety, obsessions or related emotional symptoms without defined organ damage.
Necrosis directly destroys bone; impaired blood supply alone does not establish a separate vascular disease.
Umbrella concept defined by disease of bone; additional organs depend on subtype.
Metabolic bone disorder defined by excessive osteoclastic resorption and disordered remodeling. Hearing loss, nerve compression and cardiac failure are minority complications.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: abnormal bone turnover defines this metabolic bone disorder, explicitly supported by its metabolic bone disorder parent.

basis: Pure anxiety disorder; palpitations and panic symptoms do not establish direct organ damage.
Focal seizures arise from localized cerebral dysfunction; no additional organ involvement defines this umbrella.
Umbrella for blood vessel diseases; inflammatory, coagulative and organ-specific manifestations are confined to particular subtypes.
Disease of peripheral arteries; claudication alone does not establish skeletal muscle damage.
Primary loss of ovarian endocrine function; downstream osteoporosis is a separately diagnosed disease.
Autoimmune destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts; associated thyroid disease is separate, and pigmentation or itching does not establish skin damage.
Neurologic sensorimotor disorder; the urge to move the legs does not establish skeletal-muscle damage.
Structural lateral curvature of the spine; pulmonary impairment belongs chiefly to severe cases.
Urate metabolic disease causes crystal-triggered autoinflammatory arthritis through innate immune activation. Renal stones and chronic kidney disease are separate diagnoses.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: gout is crystal-induced autoinflammatory arthritis mediated by innate immune activation; the mechanism axis includes immune-mediated disease.

basis: Cerebrovascular ischemic injury causing brain tissue necrosis; both cerebral vascular supply and neural tissue define the disease.
Umbrella category explicitly defined by neurologic dysfunction of voluntary or involuntary movement; no other organ is consistently affected.
Aneurysmal disease of the thoracic aortic wall.
Thyroid enlargement defines goiter; compression symptoms do not establish common direct airway or gastrointestinal damage.
Umbrella for predominantly oral, oesophageal and upper airway tumours; endocrine and skin origins describe additional subgroups.
Venous occlusion by an embolized thrombus is a vascular disorder; it does not itself establish a blood-cell or coagulation disorder.
Benign or malignant neoplasm arising in the colon; lymphoma is only one subtype, and distant organ involvement is not intrinsic to the umbrella.
Malignant lymphocytic proliferation primarily occupies marrow and blood; leukemia alone does not meet the lymphoma mechanism rule.
Neurologic syndrome with cognitive and autonomic dysfunction; fatigue and myalgia do not establish muscle damage, and immunodeficiency is not a defining established mechanism.
Childhood-onset asthma is an immune-mediated inflammatory airway disease; no additional organ damage is intrinsic.
Pregnancy-associated carbohydrate intolerance is diabetes; no additional organ damage defines the condition.
Immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation directly affects the esophagus.
Diabetic cataract is a lens disease; the underlying type 2 diabetes is a separately diagnosed metabolic disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hyperglycemia explains the cataract's cause, but the cataract does not itself damage an endocrine organ or constitute the underlying diabetes.

basis: Malignancy originating in the gallbladder, which belongs to the hepatic axis.
Ulceration directly damages the duodenal wall; an infectious cause is not specified.
Neonatal ileal obstruction by inspissated meconium; other cystic fibrosis manifestations belong to the underlying disease.
Treatment-refractory schizophrenia is a psychiatric disorder outside the specified axes.
Degenerative disease of knee articular cartilage and joint structures.
Choroidal neovascularization damages the retina and macula; localized ocular vessels do not imply systemic cardiovascular disease.
Structural myocardial disorder characterized by ventricular noncompaction, sometimes with ventricular dysfunction.
Substance dependence is outside the axes; associated toxic organ diseases are separate conditions.
Thyroid hormone deficiency; autoimmune etiology and lasting extra-thyroid organ damage do not apply uniformly across this umbrella.
Chronic lymphatic obstruction produces enlargement and fibrotic thickening of skin and subcutis. Lymphatics are outside the defined cardiovascular axis; infection is not universal.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: lymphatic obstruction does not establish disease of the heart, arteries, veins or blood capillaries covered by this axis.

basis: Soil-induced lymphatic obstruction causes defining chronic skin and subcutaneous changes with elephantiasis; lymphatic vessels are not explicitly included in cardiovascular.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the affected vessels are lymphatics, outside the stated cardiovascular coverage; blood-vessel disease is not established.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: chronic cutaneous and subcutaneous swelling, thickening and fibrosis constitute the defining elephantiasis phenotype.

basis: MRI establishes structural brain infarction despite absent clinical deficits; a specific vessel lesion is not established.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: the demonstrated lesion is infarcted brain tissue; arterial thrombosis or another intrinsic vascular lesion is not specified.

basis: Transmissible prion disease causes spongiform brain degeneration and neuronal loss; classified as a CNS infectious disorder.
Early-onset hypertension is an arterial pressure disorder; target-organ complications are not intrinsic universal features.
Substance dependence without an intrinsic organ-damage diagnosis; hepatic and pulmonary diseases are separate conditions.
Substance withdrawal syndrome without defining organ damage; withdrawal delirium is a distinct subtype.
Photosensitivity affects the skin; no systemic organ involvement is specified.
Autoimmune necrotizing vasculitis; glomerulonephritis occurs in roughly 60-80% and direct pulmonary inflammation or hemorrhage in roughly 40-60%.
Postoperative loss of ventricular function defines the condition.
Defined by testicular maldevelopment, cryptorchidism, infertility and germ-cell cancer; endocrine dysfunction is not established by the disease definition.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: reproductive testicular dysgenesis does not establish hormonal dysfunction; the hypogonadism ancestor alone is insufficient.

basis: Metastatic malignancy occupies lymph nodes, which have no listed anatomical axis. This is not necessarily lymphoma or a blood-cell malignancy; primary origin is unspecified.
Inherited lipid metabolism disorder; associated atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease is separately diagnosed.
Predominantly gonadal germ-cell carcinoma, outside the axes; CNS involvement belongs to a site-specific subtype.
Middle-ear inflammation is most often infectious; no additional organ damage is common across the umbrella.
Leishmania infection of reticuloendothelial tissues; splenic and marrow involvement with anemia and hepatic infiltration are defining manifestations.
Leishmania infection directly produces persistent cutaneous lesions and ulcers; mucosal or visceral disease is not characteristic of this concept.
Testicular malignancy is reproductive; endocrine dysfunction and hematologic subtypes are not defining across this umbrella.
Hepatic fibrosis and cirrhosis caused by hepatitis C viral infection.
Disease of the cardiac conduction system; cardiac muscle is cardiovascular rather than skeletal musculoskeletal tissue.
Psychiatric eating-disorder umbrella; no single pattern of direct organ damage applies to most patients across its subtypes.
Eating disorder; associated physical complications are not defining organ disease.
Structural heart disease present at birth; extracardiac abnormalities are not shared across this umbrella.
Neoplasm originates in the lung. Neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease or common hormonal dysfunction.
Trypanosomal infection with defining CNS invasion (80-99% neurologic abnormalities); infection-related anemia is common (~30%+). ECG changes alone do not establish common cardiac injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: ECG abnormalities occur in 30-79%, but substantial myocardial or conduction-system injury is not established at that frequency; AV block is 5-29%.
decisions.neurologic: primary: the characteristic meningoencephalitic stage defines sleeping sickness; neurologic abnormalities occur in 80-99%.

basis: Adenocarcinoma originates in uterine endometrium, a reproductive site outside the axes; estrogen association does not establish endocrine organ disease.
Malignant neuroectodermal/neuroepithelial neoplasm of nervous-system lineage; other sites are subtype-specific.
Calcific disease directly affecting the aortic valve.
Retinal tear or break causes detachment of the retina; this is an ocular disorder despite the neurologic ancestor.
Substance-induced psychotic disorder; this concept does not establish structural or functional neurologic injury beyond psychiatric illness.
A sleep-wake disorder defined by pathological excessive sleepiness.
Psychological response to occupational demands; no direct damage to an organ axis is defined.
Defined by abnormally low arterial blood pressure; other organ injury is not intrinsic to this umbrella concept.
Defined by a pathological postural fall in arterial blood pressure; an underlying neurologic cause is not universal.
Defined by an abnormal fall in arterial blood pressure after meals; autonomic mediation does not establish additional organ damage.
Disorder of blood-pressure regulation; an abnormal reflex does not establish structural brain disease or neurologic damage.
Disease of the temporomandibular joint; jaw location does not establish oral mucosal or dental disease.
Migraine is a neurologic disorder; transient visual aura does not establish damage to the eye.
Disease of the atrioventricular node, part of the cardiac conduction system.
Ventricular cardiac rhythm disorder.
A ventricular tachyarrhythmia arising from abnormal cardiac repolarization.
Disorder of atrial cardiac rhythm; no additional organ damage defines the condition.
Direct inflammatory skin injury; immune-mediated allergy applies only to a subset of this umbrella, which also includes irritant dermatitis.
Nickel-triggered delayed hypersensitivity causes allergic inflammation of the skin.
Hair loss defines this treatment-induced disease; the treatment exclusion for additional involved organs does not remove its primary hair axis.
Adenomatous neoplasm originating in the colon or rectum.
Psychotic disorders are explicitly outside the organ axes; the umbrella does not establish structural neurologic damage.
Congenital absence of teeth; teeth and impaired mastication belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Psychotic and mood disorder without qualifying organ damage; purely psychiatric conditions have no axis.
Idiopathic structural curvature of the adolescent spine; pulmonary damage is not typical across patients.
Neurodevelopmental reading disorder with impaired processing of written language.
Occlusion of a major cerebral supplying artery causes ischemic brain injury.
Trypanosoma cruzi-associated myocardial disease causes conduction defects and cardiomyopathy; digestive involvement is not established in most.
Mast-cell-mediated skin disease producing wheals; vascular permeability does not establish a separate vascular disorder.
Delayed anoxic brain injury following carbon monoxide poisoning.
Breast carcinoma lies outside the axes; receptor negativity does not make it an endocrine gland disease.
Disease of the adrenal gland, an endocrine organ; additional effects vary across subtypes.
Carcinoma arising from bile-duct epithelium; both intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts belong to the hepatic axis.
Defined by abnormal bone development; other organ involvement depends on the specific subtype.
Bacterial toxin blocks neuromuscular and autonomic neurotransmission; paralysis and respiratory failure reflect neural dysfunction rather than primary muscle or lung injury.
Malignant glial tumor arising in the brain.
Glycosylation synthesis disorder; neurodevelopmental impairment affects most. Intrinsic hepatic dysfunction and coagulation-factor deficiencies each commonly exceed 30%, with subtype variability.

decisions.haematologic: involved: intrinsic deficiencies of glycosylated coagulation factors commonly exceed 30% across the predominant type I presentations; clinical thrombosis is not required.
decisions.hepatic: involved: intrinsic hepatopathy/hepatic dysfunction commonly exceeds 30% in predominant type I presentations; isolated transient enzyme elevation is insufficient.

basis: Inherited glycan-processing disorders; developmental brain dysfunction affects most patients across the group (>30%). Hepatic and immune disease vary by subtype.
Dengue virus infection; rash is transient, and supplied blood, bleeding and organ complications occur in fewer than 30%.
Developmental impairment, including specific and pervasive developmental disorders, falls within the neurodevelopmental axis.
Bacterial infection usually involves oral and upper airway mucosa with pseudomembranous injury. Myocarditis and neuropathy are minority, separately diagnosed complications.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: the definition explicitly identifies the oral cavity as a usual site of pseudomembranous infection; oral mucosa belongs to this axis.

basis: Glial-neuronal tumor arising in the brain cortex, commonly causing focal seizures.
Malignancy originates in cutaneous eccrine sweat glands.
Malignancy occupying the gingiva; gums belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Multiple cartilage-capped bone tumors are obligatory; common deformities and mobility impairment remain within the musculoskeletal axis.
Most cases across this umbrella are benign dermal or subcutaneous fibrous histiocytomas; deep soft-tissue and bone variants do not represent most patients.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: benign cutaneous fibrous histiocytomas account for most patients across this umbrella, supporting skin/subcutis as the predominant origin.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: deep soft-tissue and bone tumors occur in particular subtypes; mesenchymal histology alone does not establish locomotor tissue involvement in most patients.

basis: Dilatation of renal collecting structures from impaired urine drainage; associated nausea or fever does not establish other organ injury.
Combined immunodeficiency defined by near absence of T lymphocytes and NK cells; secondary infections are separate diseases.

decisions.haematologic: primary: the definition specifies profound deficiency of T lymphocytes and NK blood cells, meeting the explicit blood-cell disease rule.

basis: Malignancy originates in the abdominal peritoneum; ascites reflects local disease. Coagulation abnormalities and ileus are occasional.
Developmental small-eye disorder with severe hyperopia and abnormal ocular anatomy; associated glaucoma remains within the ocular axis.
Malignancy involving the oral cavity; mouth and salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Developmental abnormalities of bone and cartilage define this skeletal umbrella; extraskeletal disease is subtype dependent.
Malignancy affecting the pharynx, which belongs to the pulmonary axis under the specified mapping.
Defined by reproductive anatomy and sex characteristics; endocrine dysfunction is not required across this umbrella.
Carcinoma originates in the renal pelvis, within the urinary tract.
Defective skeletal mineralization with bone weakening arises from disturbed vitamin D or mineral availability/metabolism.
Carcinoma originating in small intestinal epithelium; no additional organ involvement established.
Umbrella of inherited steroid metabolism disorders; hepatic and cardiovascular damage are subtype-dependent.
Carcinoma arising in cutaneous sweat glands, which are skin appendages.
Malignancy of T lymphocytes in marrow and blood; leukemia alone does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated mechanism.
Clostridial neurotoxin disrupts inhibitory neurotransmission. Muscle spasms reflect neurologic dysfunction rather than primary muscle damage.
Toxic injury to the brain or other nervous system structures defines this umbrella; additional organ damage depends on the specific toxin.
Umbrella of inherited vitamin metabolic defects; neurologic, skeletal and blood manifestations depend on the specific vitamin disorder.
Opioid substance dependence has no axis; overdose injury and infectious complications are separate conditions.
Morphine dependence is a substance-use disorder; no intrinsic organ damage is specified.
Immune-mediated transmural inflammation of the colon; extraintestinal organ damage is not common enough to add.
Immune-mediated ulcerative inflammation confined to the left colon.
Defined here as Crohn disease involving ileum and colon, with immune-mediated intestinal inflammation.
Immune-mediated Crohn inflammation affecting oral tissues; the mouth belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Immune-mediated ulcerative inflammation involving the entire colon; no additional organ damage consistently meets the threshold.
Immune-mediated Crohn inflammation of the anal region, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Anorectal inflammation is usually infectious or associated with immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease per the definition; radiation-related forms are exceptions.
Immune-mediated inflammation directly affects the small intestine; extraintestinal damage is not sufficiently common to add.
Structural defect of the vertebral pars interarticularis.
Acute coronary ischemia affects coronary arteries and myocardium.
Autoimmune inflammation directly targets the liver; ANA and smooth-muscle antibodies define type 1.
Severe hippocampal neuronal loss and gliosis define this age-related brain disorder.
Bacterial infection umbrella with variable sites; no single anatomical organ is established across most cases.
Defined by chronic widespread muscle pain, stiffness and tenderness; associated headaches and fatigue do not establish additional organ damage.
Carcinoma originating in renal parenchyma; no additional organ damage meeting the frequency threshold is established.
Infection defines the mechanism; no anatomical organ is consistently affected across this broad group.
Allergic immune-mediated inflammation directly affects the eye and its adnexa.
Defined by pathological changes in blood vessels of the eye.
Umbrella for inflammatory and degenerative connective tissue and joint disease; an immune mechanism is not shared across the group.
Paralysis of the eye's ciliary muscle causes loss of accommodation.
Immune-mediated glomerular inflammation caused by lupus; other systemic lupus manifestations are not intrinsic to the nephritis concept.
Umbrella disorder of calcium metabolism; skeletal, renal and soft-tissue damage varies by subtype and is not established across most patients.
Broad reproductive ovarian disease umbrella; endocrine dysfunction is not established across most structural, inflammatory and functional subtypes.
Defined by progressive loss of central nervous system tissue and neurological function; other organ damage is not shared across the umbrella.
Defined as disease affecting the brain; other organs are not shared across this umbrella.
Disease of the aorta; additional organ damage is not universal across this umbrella.
Usually arises in thoracic or upper airway epithelium. Listed leukemia, neuroblastoma and other distinct tumours are not accepted as manifestations of NUT carcinoma.
Site-unspecified embryonal malignancy; subtypes arise in different organs, so no organ axis can be assigned to the umbrella.
Neonatal withdrawal is defined by neurologic and neurobehavioral dysfunction; feeding and autonomic symptoms do not establish other organ damage.
The definition explicitly identifies an organic brain syndrome following substance reduction. Other withdrawal symptoms do not establish additional organ damage.

decisions.neurologic: primary: explicitly defined as an organic brain syndrome, so this is neurologic dysfunction rather than a purely psychiatric substance-use diagnosis.

basis: Arterial cholesterol embolization directly causes renal ischemic injury in roughly 50-80% and cutaneous ischemic lesions in roughly 35% or more.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: cutaneous ischemic lesions occur in approximately 35% or more; embolic tissue ischemia represents direct injury rather than a transient inflammatory rash.

basis: Defined as disease of blood and blood-forming organs; no additional axis applies across this broad umbrella.
Defined by increased red-cell mass or concentration; thrombosis is a complication rather than universal vascular involvement.
Secondary excess of red blood cells; underlying causes of hypoxia are separate conditions.
Abnormal tau deposition in brain neurons and glia causes neurodegeneration.
Malignancy affecting colon or rectum; other associated cancers do not establish intrinsic involvement of additional organs.
Cryoglobulin-mediated vascular inflammation or occlusion; many cases are asymptomatic. Persistent skin, renal or nerve damage is not established in >=30% across this umbrella.
Inflammatory joint disease; the umbrella includes degenerative and traumatic causes, so an infectious or immune mechanism is not universal.
Genetic generalized seizure disorder without established common damage to other organ axes.
Squamous carcinoma arising in the esophagus; cough and voice changes do not establish direct respiratory organ damage.
Psychiatric eating disorder; obesity and metabolic diseases are separate conditions rather than intrinsic organ damage.
Congenital structural defects of the left heart, valves and aortic outflow define this group.
Hypertension defines this treatment-induced vascular disorder; treatment causation does not exclude its primary organ.
Broad umbrella chiefly covering oral/salivary and upper-airway neoplasms; other anatomical sites depend on subtype.
Defined by inflammation and ulceration of oral mucosa. Treatment causation does not exclude the organ defining this disease.
Drug-induced inflammation of the exocrine pancreas defines this disease; treatment causation does not exclude its primary organ.
Carcinoma originates in breast ducts; breast has no axis. Metastatic organ involvement is not intrinsic across this umbrella.
Biofilm-mediated acid demineralization destroys dental hard tissue in pits and fissures. Teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: caries is a sugar-driven, biofilm-mediated dysbiotic disease; bacterial participation alone does not establish an infectious or immune-mediated diagnosis.

basis: Smooth-surface caries destroys dental hard tissue through biofilm-driven acid demineralization; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: caries is a biofilm-mediated dysbiotic disease; bacterial acid production alone does not establish an infection or immune-mediated disorder

basis: Chronic bacterial biofilm-driven inflammatory destruction of tooth-supporting periodontal tissues; oral structures belong to gastrointestinal.
Severe immune-mediated cutaneous reactions; persistent extracutaneous damage is not consistently common across this umbrella.
Squamous carcinoma originates in the larynx, which belongs to the airway axis.
Malignant epithelial tumour arising from renal tubules.
Neuroblastoma arises from sympathetic neural tissue; dopamine excretion alone does not establish endocrine gland damage.
Definition specifies malignant mesothelial tumor arising in the pleura.
Epithelial carcinoma arising in the ovary, a reproductive organ outside the axes; no hormone-producing endocrine origin is described.
Ovarian germ-cell tumour; reproductive tumour origin has no axis. Endocrine activity is not characteristic of the umbrella.
Benign transitional-cell papillary tumour, predominantly arising from urinary tract urothelium; no additional organ involvement established.
Site-variable carcinoma morphology; gastric and pancreatic primaries support gastrointestinal as the predominant axis; breast and lung origins also occur.
Chronic bronchial inflammation, mucus hypersecretion and airflow obstruction; ordinary smoking-related inflammation does not imply an immune-mediated disease.
VZV infection causes characteristic cutaneous infection in chickenpox and shingles; persistent neurologic injury is not common across the umbrella.
VZV reactivation directly causes ganglionitis/neuritis and vesicular skin lesions. Ocular and otologic disease occur in minority subtypes.
Osteochondrodysplasia directly damages cartilage and bone; proposed nutritional or toxic causes do not establish an endocrine or infectious disorder.
Urothelial carcinoma originates in the urinary bladder, included in the renal axis.
Arises from mesonephric remnants in the cervix or vagina; reproductive origin, not urinary tract disease.
Carcinoma originates in the exocrine pancreas with ductal and squamous differentiation.
Localized plasma-cell neoplasm; osseous disease accounts for roughly 70-80% and directly destroys bone. Upper respiratory involvement affects a minority overall.
Carcinoma arising in the lung or bronchus.
Psychiatric anxiety disorder; associated physical symptoms do not establish direct organ damage.
Systemic Salmonella Typhi infection with intestinal lymphoid invasion; transient rash and organ enlargement do not establish additional functional damage.
The supplied definition specifies hereditary cerebral amyloidosis, an inherited protein-metabolism disorder causing cerebral vessel deposition, hemorrhage and neurological injury.
audit_reason: Add metabolic_endocrine to primary: the supplied definition identifies hereditary amyloidosis, an inherited protein-metabolism disorder. Cardiovascular and neurologic remain defining axes.

basis: Defined as injury to cerebral blood vessels and classified as both cerebrovascular disease and brain injury.
Autoimmune inflammation of the thyroid; extra-thyroid damage is not shared by most patients across this umbrella.
Autoimmune destruction and atrophy of the thyroid cause hypothyroidism.
Falciparum infection of erythrocytes with cerebral sequestration and defining encephalopathy.
Major origins are oral cavity/salivary glands and pharyngeal, laryngeal or nasal airways; uncommon ocular, skeletal and neural subtypes are not generalized.
Primary malignancy of breast tissue, which has no axis; metastatic organ involvement is not implied.
Acanthamoeba infection directly damages the cornea; associated ocular complications remain within the ocular axis.
Chronic bacterial infection; cervicofacial disease with invasive subcutaneous masses, abscesses and fibrosis accounts for ~50-60%. Other organ sites individually fall below 30%.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: invasive cervicofacial soft-tissue disease affects subcutis in roughly 50-60%, causing abscesses and fibrosis.

basis: Defined by acute pulmonary injury and pulmonary vascular occlusion; underlying sickle cell disease is a separate condition.
Viral infection of the conjunctiva with conjunctival hemorrhage.
Defined here as a benign female reproductive tract neoplasm; uterine, cervical and Bartholin gland sites have no axis.
Tumour arises in female reproductive organs, outside the axes; distant metastasis occurs in a minority.
Impaired recognition caused by cerebral damage; visual or auditory agnosia does not imply disease of the eye or ear.
Symptomatic HIV infection with immune dysfunction; opportunistic diseases and Kaposi sarcoma are separate diagnoses.
Loss of voluntary initiation and speech due to frontal/anterior cingulate brain dysfunction.
Allergen-mediated hypersensitivity causes conjunctival inflammation.
Alphavirus infection umbrella; arthritis and encephalitis vary by viral subtype and are not established across the group.
Amoebic infection primarily occupies the intestine and can cause colitis; extraintestinal invasive disease is a minority.
Intestinal hookworms attach to and injure bowel mucosa; iron-deficiency anemia depends on infection burden and is a separate diagnosis; skin/lung phases are transient.
HPV produces anogenital skin lesions; perianal location does not establish anal mucosal disease as defining or present in >=30%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: perianal skin is dermatologic; anal canal involvement is neither required nor established in >=30% across this concept.

basis: Incomplete aortic valve closure causes regurgitation; the umbrella definition does not require a rheumatic or immune-mediated cause.
Inflammation of the vermiform appendix; neither infection nor an immune-mediated mechanism defines all appendicitis.
Arenavirus infection; neurologic disease, hemorrhage and visceral injury vary across infections and are not universal defining organ involvement.
Arenavirus infection with a defining bleeding disorder; additional organ damage is not consistently common across this umbrella.
Defined by infection with an arterivirid virus; no consistent target organ is specified.
Intestinal occupation by Ascaris defines the infection; transient larval pulmonary migration does not establish common lasting lung injury.
Ascaridia intestinal nematode infection, principally described in fowl; definition does not support extrapolating Ascaris pulmonary migration.
Ascaridida infection umbrella includes intestinal adult worms and tissue-invasive larvae; no single anatomical site consistently defines the group.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: intestinal localization defines some subtypes, whereas toxocariasis and baylisascariasis involve migrating tissue larvae; common GI involvement across the umbrella is unestablished.

basis: Aspergillus infection or hypersensitivity; pulmonary infiltrates and impaired lung function occur in 30-79%. Extrapulmonary injury is occasional; neutropenia usually predisposes to infection.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: direct pulmonary disease occurs in 30-79%; the umbrella also includes extrapulmonary infection and is not anatomically restricted to lungs.

basis: Astrovirus infection causes gastroenteritis through direct intestinal infection.
Chronic destructive atrophy of nasal mucosa; the nasal airway belongs to the pulmonary axis.
Avulavirus infection; human conjunctivitis is typically transient and does not establish lasting ocular damage.
Babesia infects erythrocytes and causes hemolysis. Hepatomegaly and hemolytic jaundice do not establish hepatic damage; organ failure occurs in <30%.
Protozoal infection of the large intestine causing colitis and dysentery.
Defined by injury of cervical sympathetic nerves; vertigo and ear pain do not establish damage to the ear.
Bartonella infection umbrella; erythrocyte, skin and cardiovascular disease vary by subtype and do not apply across most cases.
Facial paralysis results from dysfunction of the seventh cranial nerve.
Functional impairment of gallbladder emptying or biliary sphincter function; gallbladder and bile ducts belong to hepatic.
Avian antigens cause immune-mediated granulomatous pneumonitis, with possible pulmonary fibrosis.
Malaria-associated massive intravascular hemolysis; hemoglobin-mediated acute kidney injury is a common severe manifestation, affecting approximately 30% or more in reported series.
Intestinal protozoal infection; no common direct extraintestinal organ damage is established.
Blastomyces infects the lungs; cutaneous dissemination is variable and not reliably >=30% across all patients; bone involvement is less common.
Small-intestinal stasis and bacterial overgrowth cause malabsorption; osteoporosis and nephrolithiasis are downstream, separately diagnosed complications.
Locally aggressive neoplasm originating in bone; distant involvement is uncommon.
Rickettsial infection of vascular endothelium causes small-vessel vasculitis; the transient exanthem does not establish lasting skin damage.
Recrudescent Rickettsia prowazekii infection targets vascular endothelium and produces small-vessel vasculitis; transient rash adds no skin axis.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: endothelial infection and small-vessel vasculitis are the disease's characteristic tissue pathology, rather than a minority cardiac complication.

basis: Usually bacterial infection of terminal bronchioles and adjacent alveoli, producing inflammatory consolidation.
Brucella infection; hepatic dysfunction, arthritis and anemia/leukopenia each annotated at 30-79%. GI symptoms lack demonstrated damage; neurologic disease is uncommon.
Poliovirus damages brainstem motor neurons; respiratory and swallowing impairment arise from neural dysfunction rather than intrinsic lung or gut damage.
Human calicivirus disease predominantly causes infectious gastroenteritis; historical hepatitis E and animal examples do not establish common hepatic disease.
Campylobacter bacterial infection predominantly causes intestinal inflammation and gastroenteritis.
Substance dependence is a psychiatric condition without a qualifying organ axis; no direct common organ damage is inherent in this diagnosis.
Defined by pneumoconiosis with rheumatoid pulmonary nodules and autoimmune rheumatoid arthritis.
Infection defined by the viral genus Cardiovirus; the genus name does not establish cardiac involvement or a common damaged organ.
Bartonella infection with regional lymphadenitis; inoculation papules are transient. Ocular, hepatic, skeletal and neurologic complications are below 30%.
Cauda equina nerve compression or injury; bowel and bladder symptoms arise from denervation and do not establish direct visceral damage.

decisions.renal: none: common bladder dysfunction reflects sacral nerve injury; direct urinary tract damage is not established as a common defining manifestation.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: bowel control dysfunction reflects sacral denervation rather than direct disease of the gastrointestinal tract.

basis: Neoplasm arising in or occupying the cecum; lymphoma is only one subtype and does not define the umbrella.
HIV-associated inflammatory arteriopathy specifically affects CNS arteries; vascular, infectious and CNS disease define the concept.
Tuberculous infection directly occupies and damages the central nervous system; pulmonary disease is not required for this extrapulmonary concept.
Toxoplasma infection directly involves brain tissue, causing encephalitis or abscesses.
Obstetric disorder of the uterine cervix, outside the thirteen axes.
Chronic cervicofacial infection directly involves subcutaneous tissues with infiltrative abscesses and sinus tracts; an oral portal alone does not establish gastrointestinal disease.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: oral commensal origin and entry through dental tissues do not establish common direct gastrointestinal involvement.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: infiltrative infection of cervicofacial subcutaneous tissues with abscesses and draining sinuses defines the usual disease.

basis: Varicella-zoster infection defined by vesicular skin lesions; damaging pulmonary and neurologic complications are uncommon.
Umbrella for Chlamydia trachomatis infection; ocular, pulmonary and genitourinary sites vary by subtype, without a shared damaged organ across the group.
Human ciliate infection is chiefly intestinal balantidiasis, with direct colonic infection and inflammation.
Liver fluke infection directly occupies and inflames the biliary passages; these are within the hepatic axis.
Inhaled Coccidioides establishes primary infection in the lungs; pneumonia is annotated 30-79%. CNS, skin and joint involvement are minority manifestations.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: lungs are the usual initial site of direct Coccidioides infection; pneumonia is annotated 30-79%, while disseminated sites are uncommon.

basis: Coccidian parasitic infection, predominantly involving the intestinal tract as defined; other organ disease varies across subtypes.
Tick-borne viral infection involving marrow erythroid precursors, with common leukopenia; encephalitis is an uncommon complication despite the listed ancestry.
Viral infection and inflammation of nasal and nasopharyngeal mucosa, included in the pulmonary axis.
Coexisting Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphomas define a lymphoid-cell malignancy; no specific extranodal organ is established.
Diaphragm defect, respiratory impairment with pulmonary hypoplasia, and persistent pulmonary hypertension define disease. Malrotation 30-79% alone does not establish common bowel dysfunction.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: persistent pulmonary hypertension is explicitly defining; it affects pulmonary arteries, which belong to cardiovascular.
decisions.pulmonary: primary: respiratory insufficiency is explicitly defining, supported by pulmonary hypoplasia in 30-79%; this is direct lung underdevelopment.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: malrotation occurs in 30-79%, but common bowel injury or functional loss is unproven. [Cohort](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31200390/)

basis: Congenital ocular motility dysfunction; associated neurologic syndromes do not establish common additional neurologic damage across this umbrella.
Congenital treponemal infection; thrombocytopenia, periostitis/osteochondrosis and hepatosplenic involvement each reported in 30-79%; ocular, hearing and lung damage under 30%.
Congenital infection with a defining triad of chorioretinitis, hydrocephalus and intracranial calcifications. Hepatic, blood and hearing abnormalities are annotated 5-29%.

decisions.neurologic: primary: hydrocephalus and intracranial calcifications are defining diagnostic features, supported by CNS disease ancestry despite occasional frequencies.
decisions.ocular: primary: chorioretinitis is part of the classic diagnostic triad; retinal abnormalities are additionally annotated 80-99%.

basis: Mycoplasma infection of lungs and pleura; the supplied definition describes a veterinary disease of cattle and goats.
Contagious ecthyma is a poxvirus infection producing localized cutaneous lesions in humans.
Human coronavirus infections predominantly involve respiratory tract epithelium; common direct damage to other organs is not established across this umbrella.
Human cowpox is a viral infection characterized by localized destructive cutaneous lesions.
Heterogeneous viral infections; myocarditis, meningitis and other organ-specific syndromes do not characterize most infections.
Usually viral infection producing inflammation and swelling of the larynx and adjacent respiratory airways.
Cryptococcal infection of the meninges and sometimes brain; pulmonary damage is not established in at least 30% of meningitis cases.
Cryptococcal infection; pulmonary nodules occur in 30-79%, supporting lung occupation. Meningitis is annotated at 5-29% and is separately classified.
Cyclospora infection directly affects intestinal epithelium and causes diarrheal enteritis.
The diaphragm is skeletal muscle; impaired ventilation alone does not establish direct lung or airway damage.
Dicrocoelium liver flukes infect and occupy the biliary tract.
Viral hemorrhagic disease with blood-cell and coagulation abnormalities; gastrointestinal injury/hemorrhage and hepatitis each 30-79%; rash is transient.
Parasitic infection with liver cysts or infiltration in ~60-75%. Pulmonary involvement is usually ~20-30%, insufficiently consistent across the umbrella for inclusion.

decisions.hepatic: involved: hepatic occupation occurs in ~60-75%; the umbrella infection permits several organ sites and is not defined specifically by hepatic disease.

basis: Echinostoma are intestinal flukes occupying and injuring intestinal mucosa; ocular infection is a distinct minority subtype.
Echovirus infection has diverse presentations; no single directly damaged organ is established in at least 30% across this umbrella.
Gas-producing infection of the gallbladder; the cystitis parent is inconsistent with the definition and does not imply urinary involvement.
Infection defined by common brain and renal tubular lesions; other listed sites lack human frequency evidence.

decisions.renal: primary: common renal tubular lesions are explicitly part of the disease definition.
decisions.neurologic: primary: common brain lesions are explicitly part of the disease definition.

basis: Site-unspecified germ-cell tumor, predominantly reproductive in origin; no covered organ is shared by most cases. Extragonadal sites require site-specific labels.
Nematode infection umbrella spanning intestinal, muscular, renal and other tissue infections; no additional anatomical organ is consistently affected across the group.
Enterobius infection occupies the intestine and produces perianal symptoms; itching alone does not establish skin damage.
Enterovirus infection umbrella; digestive entry or replication does not establish common gastrointestinal damage; organ disease varies by subtype.
Immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation directly injures lung tissue; blood eosinophilia alone is not a blood-cell disease.
Enteroviral infection causes characteristic chest-wall and abdominal muscle myositis; pleuritic pain does not establish common direct pleural damage.
Suppurative infection occupying the spinal or cranial epidural space; associated osteomyelitis, sinusitis and otitis are separate diseases.
